item.title: Harris blames Trump for rising gas prices — after once saying they're the 'price to pay for democracy'
item.summary: Kamala Harris blasts Trump over surging gas prices tied to the Iran war, but her 2022 remarks on fuel costs and democracy highlight a stark contrast.

item.title: Battleground Dem says terrorists act from 'pain and frustration,' accuses Americans of being 'high and mighty'
item.summary: Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed says the U.S. should try to understand why terrorists commit "heinous acts," citing pain and frustration.

item.title: Minnesota prosecutor charges ICE agent in gun incident as Savanah Hernandez case remains uncharged
item.summary: ICE agent faces felony charges in Minnesota for allegedly pointing a gun at two people, while no charges filed in attack on Savanah Hernandez.

item.title: LIV Golf CEO confirms Saudi funding will end but says he has a plan that 'might surprise some people'
item.summary: LIV Golf CEO Scott O'Neil confirmed Saudi funding will end after this season but says he has a business plan that might surprise some people going forward.

item.title: 'Hunger Games' actor Ethan Jamieson arrested for alleged assault with intent to kill
item.summary: "Hunger Games" actor Ethan Jamieson was arrested in Raleigh, North Carolina, for allegedly assaulting three men with a deadly weapon.

item.title: 11th scientist death emerges in string of missing, dead officials with access to US secrets
item.summary: Antigravity researcher Amy Eskridge, who reportedly died in 2022, draws renewed attention amid questions about scientists dying under odd circumstances.

item.title: Turkish grad student who co-authored anti-Israel op-ed at Tufts self-deports after legal battle with DHS
item.summary: Rumeysa Ozturk, a Tufts grad student whose deportation case was terminated by an immigration judge, has self-deported to Istanbul, sources say.

item.title: NBA star hits back at NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani for blaming him over expensive playoff tickets
item.summary: Trae Young fired back at Zohran Mamdani after being blamed for expensive New York Knicks playoff tickets, despite no longer playing for the Atlanta Hawks.

item.title: Rep Burlison demands FBI probe after top US scientists vanish or turn up dead
item.summary: House Oversight member Eric Burlison demands FBI probe after a string of disturbing disappearances and deaths involving top U.S. scientists.

item.title: Anger swells as Swalwell's 'open secret' with women went unreported for years
item.summary: Eric Swalwell's sexual misconduct allegations were an open secret, critics say, as the media industry faces scrutiny for years of failing to report them.
